## Rules

- Scheduler lock uses shared production cache and is defense-in-depth; correctness lives in atomic DB lease bound to run+owner token. Only token owner may update cursor/complete/release. Lease duration exceeds one safe slice, renews with heartbeat, and expires after crash; takeover rereads durable cursor. Lock ordering is fixed and transaction-scoped. RAG:— (repo-grounded: `@plan/knowledge/research-01-remediation-architecture.json`).

## Guidance

Use two independent PostgreSQL connections/processes, not mocks. Worker 1 must hold lease while worker 2 attempts entry; assert worker 2 never calls scanner and does not mutate cursor/stats. Kill/omit release, advance beyond expiry, then worker 2 acquires and resumes exact checkpoint. Test both backlog subject key and delta owner. Do not solve only with `withoutOverlapping`; manual launch must remain protected. No broad `Cache::lock` fallback if DB lease fails.
